buildCommand: python3 tools/build_reader.py || echo '沿用已提交的 site/index.html'
ignoreCommand: bash -c 'P=${VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA:-HEAD^}; git cat-file -e "$P^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || git fetch -q --depth=100 origin main 2>/dev/null; git cat-file -e "$P^{commit}" 2>/dev/null || P=HEAD^; git diff --quiet "$P" HEAD -- site/ && exit 0 || exit 1'
